card.name: Blog comment timestamp before Report abuse
card.fires_on: The separator or space right after a comment's date and time stamp, just before a "Report abuse" link in web blog comment threads. Weaker hits fall on other timestamps and on odd spots such as the start of "DRAM" or "DRUG".

modes.label: Comment time stamps
modes.description: The break after a posted date and time, where the next comment's "Report abuse" line begins.
modes.example: 2009 12:16 PM<< |>> Report abuse Posted by: Jamie6

modes.label: Other timestamps and odd starts
modes.description: Weaker hits after log timestamps or on the opening piece of capitalized words like DRAM or DRUG.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words like viewers, observer and gear, which is a weak and unclear effect.
card.plain: It lights up at the end of a comment's time stamp in a web comment thread, just before the next comment starts.
